items.title: Sarawakian Bidayuh Suffer Highest Rates Of Nasopharyngeal Cancer Worldwide: Experts
items.summary: Experts say the Bidayuh community in Sarawak has the highest rates of nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC) globally. High NPC risk for the indigenous group is linked to genetic factors, EBV infection, environmental hazards, and consumption of salted preserved food. items.title: Revert To Percentage-Based BIW Allowance, Give Relocation Assistance Before Doctors Relocate — MMA
items.summary: MMA is deeply concerned over doctor no-shows in Sabah and Sarawak. If contract MOs are refusing permanent positions, it points to deeper problems that can't be ignored. Restore BIW allowance's progressive structure and provide relocation assistance prior. items.title: Peka B40 Screenings Reveal Undiagnosed Conditions Among Almost Half Of Participants
items.summary: Nearly 46% of 328,302 people screened by Peka B40 last year had either at least one previously undiagnosed NCD, identified as being at risk of anxiety or depression, or both. Peka B40 screening uptake as of Aug 31 varied from 15% in KL to 46% in Kelantan. items.summary: Pantai Hospital KL is the first hospital to integrate competitive social mahjong into a clinical brain health programme, offering participants a unique combination of expert medical dialogue, digital cognitive assessments, and interactive social gameplay. items.title: Heat, Haze Squeeze Livestock Farmers As Egg Output Falls
items.summary: Livestock farmers in Malaysia are spending more to protect animals from heat and haze, as some report lower egg, poultry, and milk production. Experts caution that haze alone cannot explain the losses. The post Heat, Haze Squeeze Livestock Farmers As Egg Output Falls appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Doctor No-Shows For Permanent Posts Hit Sabah, Sarawak
items.summary: On Sept 28, many medical officers (MOs) didn’t report for duty for permanent posts in Sabah and Sarawak. Doctors unofficially reported zero MOs showing up in at least four hospitals; other facilities in both states reportedly saw 70% to 76% no-shows.
